01 / WHO WE ARE

Where learning feels like belonging.

Est. 2021
EduKids Educare Centre

We believe early education is about more than preparing a child for the next grade. It is about helping them become curious, kind, capable and confident.

EduKids Educare Centre is an education centre in Bloemendal, Gqeberha, focused on creating a supportive space where children can learn through guidance, play, interaction and discovery.

We welcome young children and work with families on a case-by-case basis. Current age groups, availability and fees are shared when you enquire — just ask us on WhatsApp or via the form below.

Programmes & services

What we offer families

Clear day-to-day support for children and parents — from arrival to home time.

Full-day early learning care

Weekday care within our listed opening hours, with routines that balance play, rest, meals and guided activities.

Guided play & discovery activities

Age-appropriate sessions that build curiosity, language, motor skills and social confidence through hands-on learning.

Creative & expressive time

Art, movement and imaginative play so children can practise new skills and share what they have learned.

Parent communication & enrolment support

Easy enquiry routes via WhatsApp, phone or email for availability, visits and registration questions.

Privacy

Privacy & Data Protection

EduKids Educare Centre respects your privacy. This website is designed to share information about our centre and to help parents contact us — not to collect or store personal data on our own servers.

  • Enquiry form: When you use the enquiry form, the details you enter (name, child’s age, enquiry type and message) are used only to prepare a WhatsApp message. They are not saved in a database by this website.
  • WhatsApp & email: Conversations continue on WhatsApp or email, which are third-party services with their own privacy policies.
  • Theme preference: The site follows your device’s light/dark setting by default. If you change the theme manually, that choice is remembered in your browser’s local storage. This is not used to identify you.
  • AI assistant: Answers are generated from fixed information about EduKids already published on this site. Questions are not sent to an external server by this page.

For any privacy questions, contact us on 074 285 4524, WhatsApp, or monene.s.martin@gmail.com.
